title: Gimcraft
description: A mod created for the loyal followers of the gim troupe. Adds many gim-related features.
body:
Made by and for the loyal followers of The Gim Troupe

A mod that adds many gim-tastic features to the game! Includes 8 new blocks, 3 new items, 2 new plants, 2 new advancements, 3 new paintings, a new mob, and even a new biome?! And that's not all, as more content will be added to the mod with future updates! The purpose of this mod is to not only add more content to the Minecraft experience, but to also encourage even more exploration and creativity from the player.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CONTENTS:
Many new blocks, such as the Block of Gim, Gimmed Stems, Gimmed Wart blocks, and even Nightmare Shroomlights.

The Gimwoods Biome, which can be found in the Nether.

New Plants to accompany this new biome, such as the Gimmed Fungus and the Gimweed.

Holdable Fire!

Music???

A new mob: Gim.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Disclaimer: You may notice that some features (most notably, the wood set) are missing. All of these "missing" features will be added in a future update coming very soon.

Another Disclaimer: This mod may contain very loud sounds. Playing with high volume is not recommended.

A Final Disclaimer: Many of the features in this mod are based on the game Hollow Knight, created by Team Cherry. It's a great game, and is definitely worth checking out.

I Lied This is the Final Disclaimer: Many of the elements in this mod were made for humorous purposes, so don't expect everything to be serious.

With that being said, have fun, and gim on!
